description: Follow the call links of a definition: who calls it ("in"), what it calls ("out"), or everything a change to it can reach ("impact"). Run "impact" before changing or renaming something. Pass several names in "symbols" to trace them all in one call.

project.description: Optional project folder path when the MCP host does not pass workspace roots (defaults to server root)

symbols.description: Several names at once, instead of "symbol"

name: map_trace
title: Trace calls
